infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SeeIt uses your location to show restaurants nearby.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SeeIt uses your camera to scan QR codes at restaurants and capture photos for reviews.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SeeIt accesses your photo library so you can attach photos to reviews.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow SeeIt to use your location to find restaurants nearby.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SeeIt to access your camera to scan QR codes and take photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SeeIt to access your photos so you can attach images to reviews.
